hero_subtitle: FutbolProyect is a platform where players, coaches, data analysts, and scouts can find job opportunities in football clubs around the world.
all_profiles_desc: Explore our community of talented players, coaches, and staff. Use the filters to find exactly who you're looking for.
about_us_text: We are a platform dedicated to connecting the best soccer talents with clubs and organizations around the world. Our team is made up of former players, coaches, and technology experts who are passionate about the beautiful game.
mission_text: Our mission is to democratize access to opportunities in the world of soccer, providing a transparent, efficient, and reliable tool for both those looking for an opportunity and those looking for talent. We want to be the bridge that unites dreams and teams.
